## New tools

- **Import SVG or DXF** (Sketch › Draw). Bring in a logo, bracket or drawn shape instead of redrawing it. DXF lines, circles, arcs and polylines come in. SVG paths and basic shapes come in as outlines, sized by the file's width.
- **Round corner** (Sketch › Modify). Rounds one corner of a polyline with a 2 mm curve. Click the corner.
- **Loft** (Model). Joins two or more closed sketches on different heights into one solid. Good for tapered shapes.
- **Sweep** (Model). Slides one closed sketch along one open line or arc path. Good for pipes and rails.
- **Plate Layout** (Print › Fit). Packs the parts you pick onto the bed with a gap you set. Can turn parts 90°. Then nudge by hand. Bed size comes from the Printer and Bed fields.
- **Thin-wall check** (Print). Reports the thinnest wall in a part and where it is. Set the minimum you want, default 0.8 mm.
- **Fit test** (Print › Fit). Makes a plate with pegs and matching holes at steps of clearance. Print it, then pick the snuggest one that still slides.
- **Lattice** (Shape). Hollows a solid and fills it with a grid of struts to save plastic. Set the cell size, strut width and wall thickness.
- **Snap-fit** (Create). Adds a flexible clip arm with a hook at the tip.
- **Living hinge** (Shape). Cuts a thin slot across a block so one side bends like a hinge.

## Support Fins

- **Fill gaps** adds a fin across every bare spot at once.
- **Drop fin** lets you click one red spot to fill just that spot.

## Web edition

- **Export STEP** from the Export menu. Writes a file that opens in CAD programs. Curves come out as flat facets, so they can't be edited as true curves in CAD.

## Notes

- Everything above works the same on the desktop app and the web edition.
- Nothing changed for existing projects.
